textbookText: 6. Which of the following mirrors is used for shaving?
7. Which of the following is the nature of image formed by a convex mirror?
a. real and virtual c. real and magnified
b. virtual and erected d. virtual and magnified
8. A concave mirror of focal length f in air is immersed in water. Which of the following
is the focal length of the mirror?
9. Which of the following is true about the focal length of a concave mirror?
10. An object is placed at 20 cm from a convex mirror of focal length 10 cm.
following is true about the image?
real and at 20cm from the mirror
b. virtual and 20cm from the mirror
20 c. virtual and at 3 cm from the mirror
20 d. real and at 3 cm from the mirror
11. An erected object of size 1m is placed in front of a concave mirror at infinity. Which is
true about the size of the image formed?
of the same size as the object
half of the size of the object
two times the size of the object
a point image of no definite size
12. What will be the distance of the object when a concave mirror produces a real image of
magnification m? (The focal length of the mirror is f.)

13. A convergent beam of light converges at a point 12 cm from the pole of a convex mirror. An inverted image of the same size is formed coincident with the virtual object. What is the focal length of the mirror?
14. A spherical mirror produces a real image of a pointed object placed in front of it. The
distances of the object and the image from the mirror are 20cm and 30cm respectively.
What is the focal length and type of spherical mirror?
Answer c a a d d a b a d c d b c c
